shots.text: He fought like the hero he had been. And when it was done, he did not run. He walked away, the way a man walks out of a room he is finished with.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Cassivane, armour burned like paper, Heartstone shards growing from his shoulders, wounded, walking into a fold of darkness.

shots.text:
Spirewright. You have cost me a great deal of time.

It does not matter. At the Heart, I will have all the time there is.
shots.speaker: cassivane
shots.art_note: Cassivane looking back once, grey eyes, locket in hand.

shots.text: In his camp we found a cage of grey light, and in it, a girl with white hair who had been gone for six years.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Corvin cutting open the cage. Inside, thin and wide-eyed, Ilyra, black veins on her arms, a broken astrolabe on a chain.

shots.text: He didn't come to save me. He came to keep me. Let me help you stop him... I'm the only one he might stop for.
shots.speaker: ilyra
shots.art_note: Ilyra standing, lightning flickering along the black veins. Joins as a hero.
